summary: Run integration tests like ansible-test integration -v ping, then comment on the PR with results and ansible --version output, or with failure output if it doesn't work.
questions: How do I report my PR test results?
What command runs an integration test for one module?

answer_card.title: Run integration tests and report
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
ansible-test integration -v ping
```
Comment on the PR with your results and `ansible --version`, such as "Works for me! Tested on Ansible 2.3.0 on CentOS 6.5 and Ubuntu 14.04." On failure, paste the error output.
